Thus, 2026.14.6.7 just contains minor changes / refinements, with no bump to FSD version.

New FSD v14.3.3 rolling out now through software update 2026.14.6.7.

“Improved driver monitoring system sensitivity with better eye gaze tracking, eye wear handling, & and higher accuracy in variable lighting conditions.”

Tesla has provided an update on Full Self-Driving V14 in Australia and New Zealand, which has not been available since V13's initial introduction last year.

It appears that V14 is coming soon, but it also means new vehicles won't have access to FSD until it's available.
